$comment: JMS SP-500 syringe pump (PQ2 = B). Each number cites a row of research/50 (catalogue BRO/500-E/001 and its page) or is a gap naming what the operator manual must give.

volume.gap: the bolus volume limits and how a bolus is programmed: SP-500 operator manual (research/50 SP-22)
the purge volume limit: SP-500 operator manual (research/50 SP-23)

kvo.gap: whether the pump keeps the vein open after End or Almost Empty, and at what rate: SP-500 operator manual (research/50 SP-26)

alarmTime.gap: the time or volume to the occlusion alarm at each level: SP-500 operator manual (research/50 SP-24)

nearEnd.gap: the near-end time at which Almost Empty is raised: SP-500 operator manual (research/50 SP-21)

syringeBrands.gap: the syringe brands and models the pump is calibrated for: SP-500 operator manual (research/50 SP-25)

doseRate.gap: whether the pump takes a dose rate (mg/kg/h and similar) or mL/h only: SP-500 operator manual (research/50 SP-27)
